integrity: Proof of the all-parameter combinatorial bijection is supplied. Finite executable tests are corroborative and are not independent mathematical certification.
scientific_limitations: Synchronous deterministic binary periodic Rule 184, indexed rings with k>=1 cars and n>=2k sites. Total stopped-car delay (not relaxation time); high-density case and stochastic motion are outside the claim. An exact all-parameter proof accompanies 32 finite exhaustive checks. Historical non-indexed equivalent formulations remain possible.
title: Exact cyclic-workload distribution of total traffic delay in Rule 184
